programs.title: Alaska Gold Diggers
programs.desc: Extraordinary encounters with Sarah-Jane and her four daughters who have teamed up to restart two gold mines in Alaska.Cameras closely follow their daily struggles.

programs.title: Marooned with Ed Stafford 2
programs.desc: Former British Army captain and experienced traveler Ed Stafford continues to overcome new challenges.He became known to viewers as a steadfast man who is able to cope with any extreme situation.So far, among others:he underwent a test of survival for 60 days on one of the uninhabited islands of Fiji, where he had no supplies of food, clothing or necessary equipment.Moreover, he walked the trail leading along the Amazon River, which earned him a place in history and the Guinness Book of Records.In the next series of the program "Ed Stafford Beyond Civilization", the traveler once again sets off to the most hostile corners of the world, including the Gobi Desert in Mongolia and the crocodile-infested Guatemalan jungle.

programs.title: Naked and Afraid 7
programs.desc: Two unknown people, a woman and a man, are left in a lonely place with difficult climatic conditions.They must spend 21 days there without food, water or clothing.They can only take one item with them.Operators show how people relying on their own company learn to cooperate and make key decisions together.Viewers will see that appropriate knowledge and skills can be very useful in extreme moments and even determine survival.

programs.title: Woman at the end of the world
programs.desc: For the fifth time, Martyna Wojciechowska sets off on risky expeditions to learn about the activities, passions and dreams of women living in different cultures.

programs.title: Woman at the end of the world
programs.desc: After several years of efforts, Martyna receives permission to come to China.He visits the Shaolin Valley area, where the influence of the traditional, strict upbringing of the Chinese is most clearly visible.Currently, over 5,000 students study at the school, which originates from a legendary Buddhist monastery.He teaches them, among others:Liu Yin Ping, a fifth-degree kung fu master.She is the only woman who lives on the school premises with her husband, the vice-champion of martial arts in all of China.The woman has a five-year-old son, but she also has to be a mother to her children, the youngest of whom are five years old.Students start their day at 5:40 a.m., and at 6:00 a.m. they have their first martial arts training.They spend all their time at school and visit their parents only once a year.They believe they can achieve any goal, they just have to work hard enough.
